fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) stock has fallen 30% from its peak due to AI infrastructure spending, though peak cash burn is expected to reach $80B in 2027 before turning positive by 2029.
fields.summary_ko.1: Alphabet is planning capital expenditure of $195–$205B in 2026, Google Cloud maintains a $561B backlog, and operating margin is expanding from 23.7% to 36.2%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Fiscal Q3 revenue grew 24.65% to $127.577B, though net loss resulted in ending a 12-quarter streak of earnings beats; 24/7 Wall St. target is $376.32 (29.8% upside).
